boosterRules.paidPowerBoundary: Boosters can speed progression within caps but must not create uncapped combat, loot, or market dominance.

boostItem.playerFacingFinePrint: Stacked boosts use reduced extra value and cannot exceed the active boost cap.

petRules.paidBoundary: Pets sell convenience, style, pickup behavior, alerts, sorting, and durability support. Pets do not sell direct combat power.
petRules.rareDropBoundary: Paid pets should not increase rare drop rates unless an earnable equivalent exists and the boost is tightly capped.
